items.description: Every named room, suite, facility, experience, treatment, food dish, beverage or wine offered. Preserve each wine vintage and size and every menu line as a separate item where the source distinguishes it.

details.description: Source facts: ingredients, vintage, producer, location, room features, inclusions, restrictions or eligibility. Retain meaningful source details.

basis.description: Size, portion, person, night, duration or other price condition verbatim; do not pair a price with a different item.

dimensions_capacity_duration.description: Any stated room area, capacity, bottle size, treatment or experience duration, preserving units.

allergens.description: Only allergens explicitly attributed by the source; never infer absence or safety.
